Heya Voaters, I'm working on a small project I'd like to release before the end of the year and I'd like your input on what makes a satisfying death scream in gaming, examples are welcome.

For me I always thought the cultists' screams in Blood were both comical and satisfying.

mein leben!

Pretty much anything said by a Nazi upon death is very satisfying, IMHO!
As much as I love Mein Leben, I'd say the most important aspect these days is variety. Sucks to have really repetitive sounds if it's something that's going to be a large focus of the game.

Generally I find how difficult something is to kill is a better measure of how satisfying a death is. The harder, the better.

I also have a special place in my heart for well done gibs and splatter decals.

Audio wise there really isn't any death scream in gaming that sticks out for me. At least not in a good way. I'll notice a badly done and out of place audio clip, but barely notice the good ones.
There's always an opportunity to stick the Wilhelm scream somewhere.

1. Immediacy: Some games (e.g. Nuclear Throne) have the impact sound as part of the death sound, while other games (e.g. Diablo 2) have separate impact sounds and death sounds.

  2. Variety: Have multiple death sounds per enemy, especially if you're killing masses of them. On top of that, vary the pitch by +/- 5% before playing the individual clips.

Get some satisfying death sounds (e.g. corrupted rogues from Act 1 Diablo 2) and look at their waveform. You'll notice that they have a rather short attack and long decay (~1s).
